# Issues

The Issues tab lists everything suspicious about the request, ranked by severity. Each issue links to its row in the panel that raised it.

<!-- screenshot: issues.png generated by e2e -->
![The Issues tab with ranked findings](../assets/screenshots/issues.png)

## Sources

| Source | Trigger |
|---|---|
| Slow query | Longer than `thresholds.slowQueryMs`. |
| N+1 | Same query shape repeated `thresholds.nPlusOneMin` times or more. |
| Slow template | Longer than `thresholds.slowTemplateMs`. |
| Slow request | Longer than `thresholds.slowRequestMs`. |
| Exception | Thrown or caught and reported. |
| HTTP status | A 4xx or 5xx response, a 404 from a missing template, or an HTTP error. |
| Custom | Added by a panel with `issue()`. See [Extending Lens](../guides/extending.md#issues). |

Issues drive the color of the health strip and the issues chip: amber for warnings, red for critical findings.
